revenue.source: Makita FY3/2026 earnings release, p.10 (consolidated statement of profit or loss)

op_margin.source: Makita FY3/2026 earnings release, p.10; operating profit / revenue

gross_margin_18.source: Makita FY3/2019 release (IFRS comparative for FY3/2018)

sga_26.source: Makita FY3/2026 earnings release; SG&A / revenue

dio.source: Makita FY3/2026 earnings release: inventories / cost of sales x 365 (year-end)

dio_22.source: Makita FY3/2022 release: inventories / cost of sales x 365

net_cash.source: Makita FY3/2026 earnings release: cash + time deposits - borrowings - lease liabilities

roe.source: Makita FY3/2026 earnings release: profit to owners / average parent equity

roic.source: NOPAT / average (operating NWC + PP&E + intangibles); data/clean/ratios.csv

europe_share.source: Makita FY3/2026 earnings release, p.16 (revenue by customer location)

aftermarket.source: Makita FY3/2026 earnings release, p.15 (revenue by product category)

ev_ebitda.source: Model: Comps sheet; EV (incl. leases) / LTM EBITDA to Jun 2026

own_med.source: Model: Makita EV/EBITDA at each FY end, FY2019-26 median (makita_hist_multiples.csv)

peer_med.source: Model: Comps sheet, peer median (last reported FY)

fcf_conv.source: Cumulative FY2018-26 FCF / net income; ratios.csv

europe_lc_26.source: Model Drivers sheet: Europe revenue growth in JPY (+4.9%) stripped of the EUR/JPY change (+6.6%)

rf.source: Ministry of Finance Japan, 10Y JGB, 28 Oct 2026

crp.source: Damodaran regional CRPs weighted by Makita revenue (crp_weighted.csv)

data_checks.source: src/check_clean.py: statement subtotals, balance, cash ties, segment sums
